History site (S12, ADR-020 §G)

A site of the «Кто вас узнаёт» stand. It loads tracker.js (an image and an XHR to /history/collect) and embeds widget.html (canvas text + export) from the receiver host given as ?receiver=<hostname> (same scheme and port as this page). Open it under two different sites with the same receiver: the receiver is then seen on two sites. The page types nothing and reads no field.
